text: so then compare a chair to the player model. what is the verdict
resolution: Analysis only, no code changed: ran tools/prop-scale chair and rendered the verdict. Chair is 0.95m tall (0.47x the measured 2.01m player head-top), back tops out just above the waist (0.90m). Seat at 0.45m exactly matches the player's knee (0.44m) — sitting ergonomics are correct. But vs a real human a chairback is ~0.54x of height, so against the stylized-tall figure the chair reads ~15% short; an R4-true chair would be ~1.1m with seat ~0.50m. Flagged the coupling: raising seatHeightMeters moves the sit pose, so seat height must move with the skeleton's sit posture or stay knee-locked. Awaiting the user's call on whether to rescale the chair family.
